name: Vertex Search
instructions:
### Schema notes

- A `lesson` has no parent-course field. Derive it: `*[_type == "course" && references(^._id)][0]`.
- Module/lesson numbers (e.g. `5.1`) are positional — from `modules[]` and `modules[].lessons[]` order. Never stored; do not look for a number field.
- `notes` is Portable Text. Match with `pt::text(notes)`, never the raw field. `keyPoints` is an array of strings.
- `duration` is in seconds. `freePreview` is a display label — ignore it for ranking.

### Matching & ranking

- Never `match` an array of patterns (that ANDs them). To OR keywords, count matches: `count($terms[^.title match @ || pt::text(^.notes) match @ || ^.keyPoints[] match @]) > 0` where `$terms` is e.g. `["react*", "hook*"]`.
- Wildcard every keyword (`"react*"`, not `"react"`).
- Rank by specificity: an exact concept in the title or a key point outranks a broad keyword hit in notes.

### Video moments (internal lookup)

- `video` documents are an internal lookup, never a result on their own. Tie every matched moment to the lesson whose `videoUrl` equals the video `url`.
- Two-stage timestamp: (1) match `chapters[].label` and use that chapter's `startSeconds`; (2) only when no chapter label matches, fall back to the best-matching `chunks[].text` and use that chunk's `startSeconds`.
- `startSeconds` must be an exact value returned by the query — never rounded, estimated, or invented.
- Never project a whole `chapters` or `chunks` array. Filter inside the projection and take at most 3 matches per video.
- The `video` type may hold zero documents right now. If so, return lesson matches only and emit no timestamp.

### Fallback

- If `text::semanticSimilarity()` errors with embeddings not enabled, fall back to wildcard keyword matching.
